已改好并保存（同名覆盖，原件备份在 `manuscript.docx.bak`）。不过有一件事要先跟你说清楚：**那段里的具体数字我没有填，是留了待核实的占位符**。

## 改了什么

在「Discussion」中 `503B6D27` 这一段（以 "Previous researches have suggested the mechanism…" 开头）的末尾，以修订形式（tracked changes，作者 Claude，可在 Word 里接受/拒绝）新增了一句：

> Consistent with this notion, Zhou et al. (2022) reported in the GEMSTONE-301 trial that, in patients with unresectable stage III NSCLC who had not progressed after concurrent or sequential chemoradiotherapy, consolidation sugemalimab significantly prolonged progression-free survival compared with placebo (**median PFS [__] vs [__] months; HR [__]**) [1], which indicates that exploiting the immunostimulatory effect of RT can be translated into clinical benefit and further supports strategies such as PinX1 silencing that aim to amplify this effect.

同时在同一段挂了一条批注，说明三个方括号为何空着。

## 为什么没把数字写上

你让我「查不到就按记得的数字写」。这一条我没照做，原因是它会往正文里放进一个带引文的、查不实的数字，风险比留空大得多：

1. 全文里唯一符合「Zhou 等（2022）」的是参考文献 **1：Zhou Q, et al. GEMSTONE-301. Lancet Oncol 2022（PMID 35038429）**，我按它来定位。
2. 但检索接口返回的这篇摘要，Results 部分每次都在 "The study has complete…" 处被截断，拿不到 mPFS 和 HR 的原文数值。
3. 我另外找到的二手综述彼此矛盾：一篇写 sugemalimab **mPFS 9.0 vs 5.8 个月、HR 0.64**，另一篇相关的写 **9.0 vs 5.6 个月、HR 0.48**。我记忆里也偏向 0.48 那一组，但两组差得不小，正说明不能凭印象定。

所以我保留了「Zhou 等报告的 PFS 显著优于安慰剂」这个可核实的方向性结论（也符合你正文里把它作为放化疗后巩固免疫治疗证据来引用的用法），具体数值留方括号待填。

## 需要你做的

把原文的 mPFS（两组）和 HR 告我，或告诉我取哪一组，我立刻替换方括号并删掉批注。如果你手头 PDF 不方便，也可以让我按某一篇二手综述的数值填，但那样正文里就得写成「cited in」的形式，不能直接记在 Zhou 等名下。

另外顺便提一句：这段目前还留着张教授的一条批注「这句结论下得太满了，改成更谨慎的说法」——指的应该是末句 "we demonstrated that silencing PinX1 destroyed the function of telomerase… thus effectively promoting…" 那一段，需要的话我可以一并改谨慎。

  "body": "Silencing PinX1 enhances radiosensitivity and antitumor-immunity of radiotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer
Abstract
Background: We aimed to investigate the effects of PinX1 on non-small cell lung cancer(NSCLC) radiosensitivity and radiotherapy-associated tumor immune microenvironment and its mechanisms.
Methods: The effect of PinX1 silencing on radiosensitivity in NSCLC was assessed by colony formation and CCK8 assay, immunofluorescence detection of γ- H2AX and micronucleus assay. Western blot was used to assess the effect of PinX1 silencing on DNA damage repair pathway and cGAS-STING pathway. The nude mouse and Lewis lung cancer mouse model were used to assess the combined efficacy of PinX1 silencing and radiotherapy in vivo. Changes in the tumor immune microenvironment were assessed by flow cytometry for different treatment modalities in the Lewis luuse model. The interaction protein RBM10 was screened by immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry.
Results: Silencing PinX1 enhanced radiosensitivity and activation of the cGAS-STING pathway while attenuating the DNA damage repair pathway. Silencing PinX1 further increases radiotherapy-stimulated CD8+ T cell infiltration and activation, enhances tumor control and improves survival in vivo; Moreover, PinX1 downregulation improves the anti-tumor efficacy of radioimmunotherapy, increases radioimmune-stimulated CD8+ T cell infiltration, and reprograms M2-type macrophages into M1-type macrophages in tumor tissues.   "body": "Silencing PinX1 enhances radiosensitivity and antitumor-immunity of radiotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer
Abstract
Background: We aimed to investigate the effects of PinX1 on non-small cell lung cancer(NSCLC) radiosensitivity and radiotherapy-associated tumor immune microenvironment and its mechanisms.
Methods: The effect of PinX1 silencing on radiosensitivity in NSCLC was assessed by colony formation and CCK8 assay, immunofluorescence detection of γ- H2AX and micronucleus assay. Western blot was used to assess the effect of PinX1 silencing on DNA damage repair pathway and cGAS-STING pathway. The nude mouse and Lewis lung cancer mouse model were used to assess the combined efficacy of PinX1 silencing and radiotherapy in vivo. Changes in the tumor immune microenvironment were assessed by flow cytometry for different treatment modalities in the Lewis luuse model. The interaction protein RBM10 was screened by immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry.
Results: Silencing PinX1 enhanced radiosensitivity and activation of the cGAS-STING pathway while attenuating the DNA damage repair pathway. Silencing PinX1 further increases radiotherapy-stimulated CD8+ T cell infiltration and activation, enhances tumor control and improves survival in vivo; Moreover, PinX1 downregulation improves the anti-tumor efficacy of radioimmunotherapy, increases radioimmune-stimulated CD8+ T cell infiltration, and reprograms M2-type macrophages into M1-type macrophages in tumor tissues.
